phase: live Ghidra machine-contract reconstruction, clean-room model, focused x86-32 model verification, and vtable-base resolution by locating the class constructor

implementation.port_policy: No port was needed for the target itself. Its single callee 0x011e58c0 is a distinct function in the original and is modelled out of line, with NOINLINE, so that the one-instruction CALL the target makes is preserved; its three absolute-address globals are modelled as named host statics and are not promoted to global records.
implementation.state_policy: The only state written is receiver +0x04 and receiver +0x08.

observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: The target produces no return value. EAX carries the callee's dword result at the moment it is stored to receiver +0x08 (0x00fd946f) and is never forwarded: the only instruction after that store is POP ESI followed by RET 0x4. The imported Spore-ModAPI prototype is also void, so machine and import agree here. The upper bytes of EAX on exit are whatever the accessor's MOV EAX,[0x016f4af4] left there and are not part of any contract.
observed_original_abi.convention_derivation: The body reads its only incoming word at entry ESP+0x4, moves the receiver out of ECX into ESI, and returns with RET 0x4. The nonzero stack adjustment in the return form makes cleanup callee-owned, which excludes cdecl; the receiver register excludes stdcall; a single stack word and a receiver register give __thiscall.
observed_original_abi.receiver_use: MOV ESI,ECX at 0x00fd9465; ESI is then the store base for both stores. The receiver is never read.

ordinary_stack_arguments.name: tiling
ordinary_stack_arguments.note: The name and the SDK type come from the Spore-ModAPI import. The body stores the word verbatim with no mask, range check, comparison or conversion, so the declared C++ type is NOT established; the import label is a candidate label only.

observed_original_abi.return_semantics: void; no value is produced for the caller
observed_original_abi.saved_registers: ESI is pushed at 0x00fd9464 and popped at 0x00fd9472, so the callee-save obligation is discharged. No other callee-saved register is written.
observed_original_abi.signature_caveat: Ghidra reports no calling convention for this function and types its single 'this' parameter at Stack[0x4], which is what produces the wrong decompilation recorded under contradiction persisted-decompilation-is-wrong. The machine body, not the imported prototype, is the contract here.

flow: Read the single incoming stack word at entry ESP+0x4 into EAX.
PUSH ESI, then MOV ESI,ECX to hold the receiver across the call.
CALL 0x011e58c0, the lazy shared-object accessor, which returns a pointer in EAX.
POP ESI and return with RET 0x4.

published_words.this+0x04: the single incoming stack word, stored verbatim; no transformation and no validation
published_words.this+0x08: the dword returned by 0x011e58c0, i.e. a pointer to a process-wide lazily-initialised static object

words_proven_untouched: this+0x0c and beyond, i.e. every word the body does not write
observed_state_contract.notes: The body references no absolute address, so it touches no global directly. It contains no CALL other than the accessor, no branch, and no indirect memory read: the instruction stream is value independent.

observed_mechanics: MOV EAX, dword ptr [ESP + 0x4] at 0x00fd9460: read the single incoming stack word, before the receiver is moved out of ECX. This ordering is what proves the value stored at +0x04 is the argument and not the receiver.
PUSH ESI at 0x00fd9464 and POP ESI at 0x00fd9472: a balanced callee-save pair spanning the call.
MOV ESI, ECX at 0x00fd9465: the receiver becomes the store base; ECX is then dead.
MOV dword ptr [ESI + 0x4], EAX at 0x00fd9467: the argument is published verbatim at receiver +0x04.
CALL 0x011e58c0 at 0x00fd946a: the single direct call. The relative displacement 0x0020c451 from the next instruction address 0x00fd946f resolves to 0x011e58c0.
MOV dword ptr [ESI + 0x8], EAX at 0x00fd946f: the accessor's dword result is published at receiver +0x08.
RET 0x4 at 0x00fd9473: the callee pops the 4-byte argument word, so stack cleanup is 4 bytes owned by the callee.
Single basic block: no conditional or unconditional branch, no second call, no indirect memory read, and no absolute address. The only state change is the two dword stores.
Return semantics are void: EAX holds the accessor's result only as the source of the store at +0x08 and is never forwarded to the caller.
Raw bytes at 0x00fd9460..0x00fd9473 are 8b442404568bf1894604e851c420008946085ec2, read from SporeApp.exe whose sha256 is 25d42a7a5c4d438fb155233230f57d29e2849bfdff5c889a5d0847f0469d914e.

layout.vtable_base_evidence: The class constructor at 0x00fd95f0 executes MOV dword ptr [ESI], 0x1493d00 with ESI = ECX, and MOV ESI,ECX at 0x00fd95f6. An immediate that installs a table pointer into the receiver's first word is the constructor installing its own vtable, so 0x01493d00 is this class's vtable and receiver +0x00 is the dispatch word.

fields.provenance: Installed with vtable 0x01493d00 by the constructor at 0x00fd95f8
Written by this target at 0x00fd9467 with the incoming stack word, stored verbatim
Written by this target at 0x00fd946f with the value returned by the accessor 0x011e58c0

layout.covered_prefix_note: A proven lower bound on the offsets this target touches, not a claim about the object's total size. The class constructor at 0x00fd95f0 writes no field beyond +0x00, so the object's real extent is not established here.
layout.no_semantic_field_names_asserted: The wire struct names members word_04 and shared_object_ptr_08, not tiling_04 and not any class name for the singleton. The import label supplies the word 'tiling' for the argument and the +0x04 store, but the body performs no validation or conversion of it, and no other function in this reconstruction consumes +0x08, so neither field's declared C++ type is proven.

vtable_slot_observations.observation: Slot 0x01493d68 holds a pointer to 0x00fd9460. Measured from the base 0x01493d00 that the constructor at 0x00fd95f8 proves, the offset is 0x70, index 28. A whole-image byte scan found the 4-byte little-endian pattern of 0x00fd9460 exactly once, at this slot, so this is the function's only reference in the image and there is no direct caller.
vtable_slot_observations.tool: python3 PE section map + bytes.find over SporeApp.exe, plus ghidra_read_memory

vtable_slot_observations.observation: The table begins at +0x00 with code pointer 0x00fd95f0, then eight purecall entries (0x011e06d0) from +0x04 to +0x20, a NULL word at +0x24, a code pointer 0x00fd93a0 at +0x28, then fifteen purecall entries from +0x2c to +0x64. The concrete overrides start at +0x68 with 0x00fd95f0, then +0x6c 0x00fd9b70, +0x70 this target, +0x74 0x00c2e4e0, +0x78 0x00fd9610, +0x7c and +0x80 both 0x010829f0, a NULL word at +0x84, then +0x88 0x00fd9c40 and further. Ghidra confirms 0x011e06d0 is named purecall, which is what makes the table a vtable rather than arbitrary data.
vtable_slot_observations.tool: python3 slot dump + ghidra_get_function_by_address on 0x011e06d0 and 0x00c2e4e0

vtable_slot_observations.observation: 0x00c2e4e0 has body_start equal to body_end 0x00c2e4e0 and no instructions, i.e. it is a bare RET, matching how the sibling record for 0x00fc7e10 described the same address.

globals.provenance: Read one byte at a time by MOV CL,byte ptr [0x016f4b08] and written as a dword by OR dword ptr [0x016f4b08],EAX with EAX = 1. Tested for bit 0 by TEST AL,CL. Guard of the accessor 0x011e58c0.
Read and set in the initialiser 0x011e5870 (DAT_016f4b00 & 1). Second-level guard reached from the target's callee.
Loaded as the accessor's result by MOV EAX,dword ptr [0x016f4af4]. Assigned &DAT_016f4afc by 0x011e5870 when it is still zero. This is the dword the target publishes at receiver +0x08.

The first word of the static object. FUN_011eb950, the initialiser, stores &PTR_LAB_014f6f80 there, installing vtable 0x014f6f80. FUN_013cb3f0, registered with _atexit, calls FUN_011eb940, which stores &PTR_LAB_0140de80 there, installing base vtable 0x0140de80 at destruction. Adjacent to the pointer slot at 0x016f4af4, which is the layout that lets the atexit thunk find the object.

CMP dword ptr [0x016f4b10],0x0 with JNZ over the accessor call at 0x00fd91b7 in the large sibling constructor 0x00fd90c0, one of the accessor's four callers. Independent evidence that the accessor yields a process-wide shared object.

callees.signature_observed: one dword result in EAX, no arguments, caller-cleanup (plain RET)
callees.name: FUN_011e58c0
callees.observation: A lazy-initialisation accessor. MOV CL,byte ptr [0x016f4b08]; MOV EAX,1; TEST AL,CL; JNZ past the init; OR dword ptr [0x016f4b08],EAX; MOV ECX,0x16f4b04; CALL 0x011e5870; then MOV EAX,dword ptr [0x016f4af4]; RET. So the first call initialises and every call returns the pointer slot.
callees.second_level: 0x011e5870 performs the DAT_016f4b00 guard, calls FUN_011eb950 to install vtable 0x014f6f80 into the static object, registers FUN_013cb3f0 with _atexit, and sets DAT_016f4af4 = &DAT_016f4afc when the slot is still zero.

callers.interpretation: A whole-image byte scan for the 4-byte little-endian pointer 0x00fd9460 returned exactly one hit, at VA 0x01493d68 in .rdata, which is a vtable slot. There is therefore no direct caller anywhere in the binary and reachability is virtual-dispatch only. Ghidra's xref list for 0x00fd9460 is correspondingly empty of code references.

vtable_dispatch.note: The table is 0x01493d00, proven by the constructor immediate at 0x00fd95f8, and this target is its slot +0x70. The interface name is not established: SporeApp.exe carries no MSVC RTTI, so no class or interface name is recoverable from the binary, and the Spore-ModAPI import name is a label only.

contradictions.summary: Both persisted decompilations of this function (.spore-analysis/ghidra-exports/decompiled_sdk/UTFWin__ImageDrawable__SetTiling.c and tools/mcp/cache/decompiled/25d42a7a5c4d/0xbd9460.c) render the body as "*(IImageDrawable **)(in_ECX + 4) = this;" followed by the accessor call and a store to +0x8. That makes the first store look like it publishes the receiver. It does not. Ghidra could not determine the calling convention, typed the ECX parameter as int and mapped the real stack argument onto the same name 'this', and then folded the load away. The live disassembly shows the store's source is EAX, which was loaded from entry ESP+0x4 at 0x00fd9460, one instruction before the receiver is moved. The reconstructed model follows the machine body.

The task briefing lists vtables: ["vtable:0x01493d20"], and the sibling record for 0x00fc7e10 names 0x01493d00 for this address. The constructor at 0x00fd95f0 settles it: MOV dword ptr [ESI],0x1493d00 with ESI = ECX is a vtable installation into receiver +0x00, so 0x01493d00 is the base. A dump confirms 0x01493d20 is merely a slot inside it (the 0x00fd93a0 entry) that happens to begin a fifteen-entry purecall run, which is what makes it look like a base. This target is therefore slot +0x70, index 28, not +0x48.

possible_readings: The constructor at 0x00fd95f0 is a base sub-object constructor that only installs the vtable and delegates the rest, and 0x00f47380 (called conditionally) or a derived constructor writes +0x04 and +0x08.
The two words are set by every user before any read, so the object may be created in already-zeroed storage.
contradictions.summary: 0x00fd95f0 is only 22 bytes: it installs vtable 0x01493d00, conditionally calls 0x00f47380 when the argument's bit 0 is set, and returns ESI. It writes no field beyond +0x00, yet this target writes +0x04 and +0x08. Which constructor covers those two words is not established by this reconstruction.

ghidra_list_class_members groups five functions under IImageDrawable purely by this_type, including 0x00fcc100 and 0x0093b630. Their bodies use +0x04 as a pointer to be called and +0x08 as a boolean, which is inconsistent with this target's use of the same offsets as a verbatim word and a shared-object pointer. The grouping is therefore a heuristic, not a shared layout claim, and no field offset from those two functions is attributed to this receiver.

The accessor's result is a pointer to a lazily-initialised, atexit-destructed static object at 0x016f4afc whose vtable is 0x014f6f80. No function in this reconstruction consumes receiver +0x08, so the element type, the class name and the role of the shared object are all unestablished. The four-entry vtable at 0x014f6f80 was read but its slots carry no names.

codegen_equivalence.method: clang++ -m32 -std=c++17 -O2 -c, then objdump -d of the emitted set_tiling_00fd9460 body compared against the original bytes read from SporeApp.exe
codegen_equivalence.release_o2_difference: Measured with -fno-pic, because the default host configuration materialises the address of a file-scope static with a get_pc_thunk sequence that the original has no counterpart for. The semantic spine is identical and in the same order: PUSH ESI, MOV ESI,ECX, load the argument, store it at +0x04, one CALL to the accessor, store the result at +0x08, POP ESI, RET 0x4. Three subsequences are byte-identical to the original: 89ce (MOV ESI,ECX), 894608 (MOV [ESI+8],EAX) and c20400 (RET 0x4). The differences are a three-byte SUB ESP,0x8 that __thiscall on i386 inserts so the stack argument lands on a 4-byte boundary, the resulting +0xc shift in the argument displacement, one-byte use of ECX instead of ESI for the +0x04 store, and the matching ADD ESP,0x8. At the default host configuration the model body is 38 bytes, because the same get_pc_thunk is materialised twice.
codegen_equivalence.noinline_note: The accessor is declared NOINLINE. Without it clang folds the guard bytes and the pointer slot into the target and the one-instruction CALL the original makes disappears, which is a fidelity loss rather than a gain. The original keeps 0x011e58c0 as a separate function, so out of line is the faithful shape.

notes: Each test seeds all three covered receiver words with distinct sentinels, so a store to an unproven offset would be caught by the memcmp in test_only_the_two_published_offsets_change, which runs 64 argument values and compares the whole receiver with the two published words masked out.
test_store_source_is_the_argument_not_the_receiver exists specifically to pin the contradiction above: it asserts that +0x04 receives the argument and not the receiver value.

test_shared_object_pointer_is_stable_and_shared asserts the +0x08 value is identical across two different receivers with different arguments, which is only possible if it came from the accessor and not from a copy of the argument.
test_callee_pops_the_argument_word calls through a function pointer typed __thiscall with one stack word, which exercises the RET 0x4 cleanup contract.
All four configurations were built and run; check() aborts on failure and process exit status was verified.

runtime_gates: No original-process invocation or indirect-caller trace was captured, so no concrete caller is known and the tiling values a real caller passes cannot be observed.
The declared C++ types of receiver +0x04 and +0x08 are not established. +0x04 is stored verbatim with no validation, and the import label ImageTiling is a candidate label, not machine evidence.
The C++ type, class name and role of the shared static object whose pointer is published at +0x08 are unestablished; its vtable 0x014f6f80 carries no names, and SporeApp.exe has no MSVC RTTI.
Which constructor initialises +0x04 and +0x08 is unresolved: 0x00fd95f0 installs only the vtable and writes no field beyond +0x00.
The interface identity of vtable slot +0x70 of 0x01493d00 is unresolved; the eighteen purecall entries show it is a wide interface but not which one.

runtime_validation.reason: Original-process experiment requires human approval and the machine lock; none was performed for this target.

reconstruction_constraints_respected.note: Only the four files listed in source_files and this sidecar were written. All Ghidra interaction was read-only queries; the vtable base was resolved by a byte scan of the on-disk PE, not by mutating the program.

confidence_note: The ABI, the control flow, both field offsets, the callee and its global addresses are CONFIRMED from the machine body and are byte-exact. Field-meaning attribution is deliberately partial: no semantic field name and no declared type is asserted for either written word, because the body validates nothing and no consumer of +0x08 was found.
unresolved_questions: What is the declared C++ type of the word at receiver +0x04? The Spore-ModAPI import calls the argument ImageTiling tiling, but the body stores it verbatim with no mask, comparison or conversion, so the import label is not machine-confirmed.

What is the shared static object whose pointer is published at receiver +0x08? Its storage is 0x016f4afc, its pointer slot 0x016f4af4, its vtable 0x014f6f80 and its base vtable at destruction 0x0140de80, but no name or element type is recoverable and no other function in this reconstruction reads +0x08.

Why does the target publish the shared-object pointer at all? SetTiling's own contract needs only the tiling word, so the +0x08 store is an incidental side effect of the source it was compiled from, whose shape is not established.
Which constructor initialises receiver +0x04 and +0x08? 0x00fd95f0, which installs vtable 0x01493d00, is only 22 bytes and writes no field beyond +0x00.
Which C++ class and which interface own vtable 0x01493d00, and what is slot +0x70 of it? The eighteen purecall entries show a wide interface; the name is not recoverable without RTTI.

Is the sibling SDK-named GetTiling at 0x00fc7e10 the matching accessor for this target's +0x04 word? It publishes two stack words at +0x08 and +0x10 of a receiver in the 0x01491730/0x01492140/0x01493990 family, which is a different class from this one, so the pairing is not established.
What are the fifteen purecall slots at +0x2c..+0x64 of 0x01493d00? They are unresolved by definition, and the width of the interface constrains but does not identify it.
